title: Weight of nonfalsified terms
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates of the $n$-dimensional sign cube, with width $r$ equal to its number of literals. Give each coordinate restriction independently weight $1/2$ when free and $1/4$ for each of the two fixed signs, and let the weight of an assignment be the product of its coordinate weights. The total weight of assignments under which no literal of $T$ is falsified is $(3/4)^r$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term whose literal indices are pairwise distinct
